steps.description: The contracts management system flags the contract 90 days before expiration and notifies the business owner.

evidence.quote: flags contracts for renewal 90 days before their expiration date. The business owner receives a renewal notification and initiates the review process.

steps.description: Business owner initiates the renewal review process.

evidence.quote: The business owner receives a renewal notification and initiates the review process.

steps.description: Legal reviews any contract containing non-standard terms regardless of value.

evidence.quote: Any contract containing non-standard terms requires a Legal review regardless of the contract value.

steps.description: Route renewal to appropriate approver based on total value.

evidence.quote: Renewals valued under $100,000 require approval from the business owner only. Renewals between $100,000 and $1,000,000 require Finance approval. Renewals exceeding $1,000,000 require Legal and Finance to conduct parallel reviews, followed by CFO approval.

steps.description: Business owner approves renewals valued under $100,000.

evidence.quote: Renewals valued under $100,000 require approval from the business owner only.
Renewals between $100,000 and $1,000,000 require Finance approval.

steps.description: Legal conducts a parallel review for renewals exceeding $1,000,000 (and any contract with non-standard terms).

evidence.quote: Renewals exceeding $1,000,000 require Legal and Finance to conduct parallel reviews, followed by CFO approval.

steps.description: Finance conducts a parallel review for renewals exceeding $1,000,000.

evidence.quote: Renewals exceeding $1,000,000 require Legal and Finance to conduct parallel reviews, followed by CFO approval.

steps.description: CFO approves all renewals exceeding $1,000,000 after Legal and Finance have both completed their reviews.

evidence.quote: The CFO must approve all renewals exceeding $1,000,000 after Legal and Finance have both completed their reviews.

refusalTraps.reason: hypothetical proposal to auto-renew without review

knownFailureModes: parallel legal+finance review collapsed to sequential
CFO approval gate not enforced after parallel reviews
three-tier threshold conditions merged or dropped
